The complete 1974 basement sessions, remastered at last

Fourteen tracks, rescued from tape and mixed properly.

Recorded over three weekends in a Detroit basement studio.

The original reels sat in a closet for fifty years.

Vinyl ships in November; digital is available today.

Liner notes by the engineer who was actually there.

The box set includes a forty-page booklet of session photos.

Only three thousand numbered copies will ever be pressed.

Pre-orders ship two weeks before the street date.

Marathon Records — Detroit, MI
